raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`flashinfer.decode.trtllm_batch_decode_with_kv_cache_mla` rebuilds its runner objects and tuning config and calls `AutoTuner.choose_one` on every call. CUDA-graph replay skips that host code, but eager decode (`--disable-cuda-graph`, batches above `cuda_graph_max_bs`) pays it once per layer per step.

## Modifications

- New `python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/trtllm_mla_decode_cache.py` with `cached_trtllm_mla_decode`, which keeps only the `(runner_kind, tactic)` decision chosen across FlashInfer's SM10x candidate runners (`trtllm-gen` and `cute-dsl`) per shape and builds only the selected runner on every call from the caller's tensors and exact `max_seq_len`:
  - outputs are bitwise identical to the public API, both untuned and after `flashinfer.autotune(True)`;
  - no tensor is cached, so the KV pool and workspace can be freed or re-created at any time (memory saver, weight sync);
  - the key has no per-layer state, so all layers share the same entry within a FlashInfer seq-len / 128-token K-tile bucket; LRU-bounded (4096 entries), skipped while FlashInfer is autotuning or inside an active tuning context, and invalidated when profiling results or loaded config files (`load_configs`) change;
  - LSE requests, non-SM10x devices (e.g. SM120 XQA), boundary/unaligned inputs, FlashInfer builds without the runner classes (`flashinfer.mla._core`), and builds whose dispatcher caches the decision itself (`AutoTuner.selection_cache_token`) use the public API unchanged.
- `TRTLLMMLABackend._run_decode_kernel` calls it when `SGLANG_TRTLLM_MLA_CACHE_DECODE_RUNNER=1` (default off) and skip-softmax is not enabled.
- New `test/registered/attention/test_trtllm_mla_decode_cache.py` (14 unit tests).

## Accuracy Tests

Outputs are bitwise identical (`torch.equal`) to `trtllm_batch_decode_with_kv_cache_mla` on every tested shape, both untuned and after `flashinfer.autotune(True)` (including shapes where autotuning selects `CuteDslMlaDecodeRunner`), as well as non-power-of-two `max_seq_len` with eager-sized (4096-token) page tables and explicit `backend="cute-dsl"`. The unit test suite covers H in {16, 128}, B in {1..64}, ragged lengths, LSE requests, growing `max_seq_len`, multiple layers sharing entries, KV/workspace release (`weakref`), tuning-context bypass, `load_configs` / `_dirty_seq` invalidation, non-SM10x fallback, boundary/invalid input error contracts, and missing-API fallback.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

B200, BF16 KV, page size 64, 4096-token page tables, H in {16, 128}, B in {1, 8, 32, 128}, `max_seq_len` 1500, interleaved runs against the public API:

| Metric | Result |
|---|---|
| Host time per decode call | 3.6x-4.5x lower (also with `max_seq_len` growing every step) |
| Eager per-call latency | 1.7x-2.6x lower |
| CUDA-graph replay | unchanged (-2.0% to +2.8%) |
| Outputs | bitwise identical on 8/8 shapes (untuned) and 7/7 shapes (after `autotune(True)`) |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the Code Formatting with Pre-Commit.
- [x] Add unit tests.
- [ ] Update documentation (flag documented in `environ.py`).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results.

Could a maintainer add `run-ci` and review? Every test job was skipped; the red checks are `pr-gate` and the `*-finish` jobs that wait on it.

In eager decode (`--disable-cuda-graph`, or batches above `cuda_graph_max_bs`), FlashInfer rebuilds its MLA decode runners and runs `AutoTuner.choose_one` once per layer per step. This PR caches only the chosen `(runner, tactic)` per shape, no tensors, behind `SGLANG_TRTLLM_MLA_CACHE_DECODE_RUNNER` (default off). Outputs are bitwise identical to the public API, untuned and after `flashinfer.autotune(True)`; CUDA-graph replay does not change.

flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#8233 proposes the same cache inside FlashInfer. On builds that expose `AutoTuner.selection_cache_token` (added there), this helper calls the public API unchanged, so the two PRs do not conflict.

Test: `test/registered/attention/test_trtllm_mla_decode_cache.py`.

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

@@ -0,0 +1,642 @@
+"""Skip flashinfer's per-call MLA decode dispatch work in trtllm_mla eager decode.
+
+``flashinfer.decode.trtllm_batch_decode_with_kv_cache_mla`` builds its runner
+objects and tuning config and asks ``AutoTuner.choose_one`` for a tactic on
+every call. CUDA-graph replay never runs that host code, but eager decode pays
+it once per layer per step.
+
+``cached_trtllm_mla_decode`` keeps only the ``(runner_kind, tactic)`` decision
+chosen across FlashInfer's candidate runners (``trtllm-gen`` and ``cute-dsl``)
+for a workload shape and builds the selected runner on every call from the
+caller's tensors and exact ``max_seq_len``:
+
+- Outputs are bitwise identical to the public API, both untuned and after
+  ``flashinfer.autotune(True)``.
+- No tensor is cached, so the KV pool and workspace can be freed or re-created
+  at any time (memory saver, weight sync).
+- Entries hold no per-layer state, so all layers share the same entry within a
+  FlashInfer seq-len / 128-token K-tile bucket.
+
+The fast path needs the runner classes in ``flashinfer.mla._core`` (flashinfer
+<= 0.7.2). Calls that request the LSE, flashinfer builds without those classes,
+and builds whose dispatcher caches the decision itself
+(``AutoTuner.selection_cache_token``) use the public API unchanged.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from collections import OrderedDict
+from inspect import Parameter, signature
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+# Keys hold no per-layer state, so the cache grows with the number of distinct
+# (batch size, max_seq_len bucket) pairs only.
+_TACTIC_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES = 4096
+
+_CUTE_DSL_RUNNER_PARAMS = frozenset(
+    {
+        "kv_cache",
+        "workspace_buffer",
+        "kv_lora_rank",
+        "qk_nope_head_dim",
+        "qk_rope_head_dim",
+        "max_seq_len",
+        "softmax_scale",
+        "output_scale",
+        "out_dtype",
+        "enable_pdl",
+        "is_var_seq",
+        "uses_shared_paged_kv_idx",
+        "lse",
+        "return_lse",
+        "sinks",
+        "cute_dsl_impl",
+        "enable_dcp",
+        "cp_world",
+        "cp_rank",
+    }
+)
+_TRTLLM_GEN_RUNNER_PARAMS = frozenset(
+    {
+        "kv_cache",
+        "workspace_buffer",
+        "sm_count",
+        "qk_nope_head_dim",
+        "kv_lora_rank",
+        "qk_rope_head_dim",
+        "max_seq_len",
+        "sparse_mla_top_k",
+        "bmm1_scale",
+        "bmm2_scale",
+        "sinks",
+        "skip_softmax_threshold_scale_factor",
+        "enable_pdl",
+        "is_var_seq",
+        "uses_shared_paged_kv_idx",
+        "return_lse",
+        "lse",
+        "use_fp16_softmax",
+    }
+)
+
+
+class _LruCache(OrderedDict):
+    def __init__(self, max_entries: int):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.max_entries = max_entries
+
+    def lookup(self, key):
+        value = self.get(key)
+        if value is not None:
+            self.move_to_end(key)
+        return value
+
+    def insert(self, key, value) -> None:
+        self[key] = value
+        self.move_to_end(key)
+        while len(self) > self.max_entries:
+            self.popitem(last=False)
+
+
+_TACTIC_CACHE = _LruCache(_TACTIC_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES)
+_DEVICE_INFO_CACHE: dict = {}
+_CUTE_DSL_SUPPORT_CACHE: dict = {}
+_FI_RUNNER_API = (
+    None  # None: not probed yet; False: use the public API; tuple: symbols.
+)
+
+
+def _device_info(device: torch.device) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    info = _DEVICE_INFO_CACHE.get(device)
+    if info is None:
+        props = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device)
+        info = (props.major, props.multi_processor_count)
+        _DEVICE_INFO_CACHE[device] = info
+    return info
+
+
+def _probe_runner_extra_kwargs(
+    runner_cls, supplied_params: frozenset[str]
+) -> Optional[dict[str, object]]:
+    try:
+        params = signature(runner_cls.__init__).parameters
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return None
+    has_var_kw = any(p.kind == Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD for p in params.values())
+    accepted_kw = {
+        name
+        for name, p in params.items()
+        if p.kind in (Parameter.POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD, Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY)
+    }
+    if not has_var_kw and not supplied_params.issubset(accepted_kw):
+        return None
+    extra: dict[str, object] = {}
+    if "return_lse_base" in accepted_kw:
+        # flashinfer 0.7.1-0.7.2 added required keyword-only
+        # `return_lse_base: Optional[Literal["basee", "base2"]]`.
+        extra["return_lse_base"] = None
+    covered = supplied_params | extra.keys() | {"self"}
+    for name, p in params.items():
+        if (
+            p.default is Parameter.empty
+            and p.kind
+            in (
+                Parameter.POSITIONAL_ONLY,
+                Parameter.POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD,
+                Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY,
+            )
+            and name not in covered
+        ):
+            return None
+    return extra
+
+
+def _flashinfer_runner_api():
+    """flashinfer's MLA decode runner classes and helpers, or None.
+
+    None means the public API should be used: either the classes are gone, or
+    the dispatcher already caches its decision (newer flashinfer).
+    """
+    global _FI_RUNNER_API
+    if _FI_RUNNER_API is None:
+        try:
+            from flashinfer.autotuner import AutoTuner
+            from flashinfer.mla._core import (
+                CuteDslMlaDecodeRunner,
+                TrtllmGenMlaDecodeRunner,
+                _build_mla_decode_tuning_config,
+                _cute_dsl_incompatibility_reason,
+                _resolve_trtllm_gen_multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer,
+                _round_to_seq_len_bucket,
+            )
+        except ImportError as e:
+            logger.info(
+                "flashinfer MLA decode runner classes are unavailable (%s); "
+                "trtllm_mla decode uses the public flashinfer API.",
+                e,
+            )
+            _FI_RUNNER_API = False
+        else:
+            if hasattr(AutoTuner, "selection_cache_token"):
+                _FI_RUNNER_API = False  # flashinfer caches the dispatch decision itself
+            else:
+                cute_extra_kwargs = _probe_runner_extra_kwargs(
+                    CuteDslMlaDecodeRunner, _CUTE_DSL_RUNNER_PARAMS
+                )
+                trtllm_extra_kwargs = _probe_runner_extra_kwargs(
+                    TrtllmGenMlaDecodeRunner, _TRTLLM_GEN_RUNNER_PARAMS
+                )
+                if cute_extra_kwargs is None or trtllm_extra_kwargs is None:
+                    logger.info(
+                        "flashinfer MLA decode runner signature does not match "
+                        "expected parameters; trtllm_mla decode uses the public "
+                        "flashinfer API."
+                    )
+                    _FI_RUNNER_API = False
+                else:
+                    _FI_RUNNER_API = (
+                        AutoTuner,
+                        CuteDslMlaDecodeRunner,
+                        TrtllmGenMlaDecodeRunner,
+                        _build_mla_decode_tuning_config,
+                        _cute_dsl_incompatibility_reason,
+                        _resolve_trtllm_gen_multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer,
+                        _round_to_seq_len_bucket,
+                        cute_extra_kwargs,
+                        trtllm_extra_kwargs,
+                    )
+    return _FI_RUNNER_API or None
+
+
+def _cute_dsl_reason(
+    incompat_fn,
+    query_4d: torch.Tensor,
+    out_dtype: torch.dtype,
+    bmm1_scale,
+    bmm2_scale,
+    qk_rope_head_dim: int,
+    kv_lora_rank: int,
+    page_size: int,
+) -> Optional[str]:
+    if isinstance(bmm1_scale, torch.Tensor) or isinstance(bmm2_scale, torch.Tensor):
+        return incompat_fn(
+            query_4d,
+            out_dtype,
+            bmm1_scale,
+            bmm2_scale,
+            None,
+            0,
+            None,
+            True,
+            qk_rope_head_dim,
+            kv_lora_rank,
+            page_size,
+            True,
+            use_fp16_softmax=False,
+            cute_dsl_impl="auto",
+            enable_dcp=False,
+            cp_world=1,
+        )
+    key = (
+        query_4d.device,
+        query_4d.dtype,
+        out_dtype,
+        page_size,
+        query_4d.shape[1],
+        query_4d.shape[2],
+        kv_lora_rank,
+        qk_rope_head_dim,
+    )
+    if key not in _CUTE_DSL_SUPPORT_CACHE:
+        _CUTE_DSL_SUPPORT_CACHE[key] = incompat_fn(
+            query_4d,
+            out_dtype,
+            bmm1_scale,
+            bmm2_scale,
+            None,
+            0,
+            None,
+            True,
+            qk_rope_head_dim,
+            kv_lora_rank,
+            page_size,
+            True,
+            use_fp16_softmax=False,
+            cute_dsl_impl="auto",
+            enable_dcp=False,
+            cp_world=1,
+        )
+    return _CUTE_DSL_SUPPORT_CACHE[key]
+
+
+def _tuner_token(tuner) -> Optional[tuple]:
+    """None while tuning; otherwise a value that changes when tuner state changes."""
+    if (
+        tuner.is_tuning_mode
+        or tuner._active_tuning_contexts
+        or tuner.__dict__.get("_managed_cache") is not None
+    ):
+        return None
+    return (
+        id(tuner),
+        tuner._dirty_seq,
+        len(tuner.profiling_cache),
+        len(tuner._file_configs),
+    )
+
+
+def _public_decode(
+    *,
+    query,
+    kv_cache,
+    block_tables,
+    seq_lens,
+    max_seq_len,
+    bmm1_scale,
+    bmm2_scale,
+    qk_nope_head_dim,
+    kv_lora_rank,
+    qk_rope_head_dim,
+    workspace_buffer,
+    multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer,
+    out,
+    return_lse,
+    enable_pdl,
+    backend,
+):
+    from flashinfer.decode import trtllm_batch_decode_with_kv_cache_mla
+
+    # Same keyword arguments as TRTLLMMLABackend's uncached call.
+    extra_kwargs = {"backend": backend} if backend != "trtllm-gen" else {}
+    if backend == "trtllm-gen":
+        extra_kwargs["multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer"] = multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer
+    return trtllm_batch_decode_with_kv_cache_mla(
+        query=query,
+        kv_cache=kv_cache,
+        enable_pdl=enable_pdl,
+        workspace_buffer=workspace_buffer,
+        qk_nope_head_dim=qk_nope_head_dim,
+        kv_lora_rank=kv_lora_rank,
+        qk_rope_head_dim=qk_rope_head_dim,
+        block_tables=block_tables,
+        seq_lens=seq_lens,
+        max_seq_len=max_seq_len,
+        out=out,
+        bmm1_scale=bmm1_scale,
+        bmm2_scale=bmm2_scale,
+        return_lse=return_lse,
+        **extra_kwargs,
+    )
+
+
+def cached_trtllm_mla_decode(
+    *,
+    query: torch.Tensor,

+``flashinfer.decode.trtllm_batch_decode_with_kv_cache_mla``. Outputs must match
+the public API bit for bit, the cache must hold no tensors, one entry must serve
+all layers and a growing ``max_seq_len``, and LSE requests must go through the

+def _make_inputs(batch, heads, seq_lens, pages_per_seq, seed):
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    num_pages = batch * pages_per_seq

+        (batch, 1, heads, _KV_LORA_RANK + _QK_ROPE_HEAD_DIM),
+        device="cuda",

+        generator=gen,

+        (num_pages, 1, _PAGE_SIZE, _KV_LORA_RANK + _QK_ROPE_HEAD_DIM),
+        device="cuda",
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        generator=gen,

+    perm = torch.randperm(num_pages, device="cuda", generator=gen).to(torch.int32)
+    block_tables = perm.view(batch, pages_per_seq).contiguous()

+    ):
+        from flashinfer.mla import _core as fi_core
+
+        real_cute = fi_core.CuteDslMlaDecodeRunner
+        real_trtllm = fi_core.TrtllmGenMlaDecodeRunner
+        real_cute_extra = (
+            self.mod._probe_runner_extra_kwargs(
+                real_cute, self.mod._CUTE_DSL_RUNNER_PARAMS
+            )
+            or {}
+        )
+        real_trtllm_extra = (
+            self.mod._probe_runner_extra_kwargs(
+                real_trtllm, self.mod._TRTLLM_GEN_RUNNER_PARAMS
+            )
+            or {}
+        )
+        seen_cute: list[dict] = []
+        seen_trtllm: list[dict] = []
+
+        class CuteDslMlaDecodeRunner(real_cute):
+            def __init__(
+                self,
+                *,
+                kv_cache,
+                workspace_buffer,
+                kv_lora_rank,
+                qk_nope_head_dim,
+                qk_rope_head_dim,
+                max_seq_len,
+                softmax_scale,
+                output_scale,
+                out_dtype,
+                enable_pdl,
+                is_var_seq,
+                uses_shared_paged_kv_idx,
+                lse,
+                return_lse,
+                return_lse_base,
+                sinks,
+                cute_dsl_impl,
+                enable_dcp=False,
+                cp_world=1,
+                cp_rank=0,
+            ):
+                seen_cute.append({"return_lse_base": return_lse_base})
+                kw = dict(
+                    kv_cache=kv_cache,
+                    workspace_buffer=workspace_buffer,
+                    kv_lora_rank=kv_lora_rank,
+                    qk_nope_head_dim=qk_nope_head_dim,
+                    qk_rope_head_dim=qk_rope_head_dim,
+                    max_seq_len=max_seq_len,
+                    softmax_scale=softmax_scale,
+                    output_scale=output_scale,
+                    out_dtype=out_dtype,
+                    enable_pdl=enable_pdl,
+                    is_var_seq=is_var_seq,
+                    uses_shared_paged_kv_idx=uses_shared_paged_kv_idx,
+                    lse=lse,
+                    return_lse=return_lse,
+                    sinks=sinks,
+                    cute_dsl_impl=cute_dsl_impl,
+                    enable_dcp=enable_dcp,
+                    cp_world=cp_world,
+                    cp_rank=cp_rank,
+                )
+                if "return_lse_base" in real_cute_extra:
+                    kw["return_lse_base"] = return_lse_base
+                super().__init__(**kw)
+
+        class TrtllmGenMlaDecodeRunner(real_trtllm):
+            def __init__(
+                self,
+                *,
+                kv_cache,
+                workspace_buffer,
+                sm_count,
+                qk_nope_head_dim,
+                kv_lora_rank,
+                qk_rope_head_dim,
+                max_seq_len,
+                sparse_mla_top_k,
+                bmm1_scale,
+                bmm2_scale,
+                sinks,
+                skip_softmax_threshold_scale_factor,
+                enable_pdl,
+                is_var_seq,
+                uses_shared_paged_kv_idx,
+                return_lse,
+                lse,
+                return_lse_base,
+                use_fp16_softmax=None,
+            ):
+                seen_trtllm.append({"return_lse_base": return_lse_base})
+                kw = dict(
+                    kv_cache=kv_cache,
+                    workspace_buffer=workspace_buffer,
+                    sm_count=sm_count,
+                    qk_nope_head_dim=qk_nope_head_dim,
+                    kv_lora_rank=kv_lora_rank,
+                    qk_rope_head_dim=qk_rope_head_dim,
+                    max_seq_len=max_seq_len,
+                    sparse_mla_top_k=sparse_mla_top_k,
+                    bmm1_scale=bmm1_scale,
+                    bmm2_scale=bmm2_scale,
+                    sinks=sinks,
+                    skip_softmax_threshold_scale_factor=skip_softmax_threshold_scale_factor,
+                    enable_pdl=enable_pdl,
+                    is_var_seq=is_var_seq,
+                    uses_shared_paged_kv_idx=uses_shared_paged_kv_idx,
+                    return_lse=return_lse,
+                    lse=lse,
+                    use_fp16_softmax=use_fp16_softmax,
+                )
+                if "return_lse_base" in real_trtllm_extra:
+                    kw["return_lse_base"] = return_lse_base
+                super().__init__(**kw)
+
+        args = _make_inputs(2, 128, [1024] * 2, 1024 // _PAGE_SIZE, seed=41)
+        ref = self._public(*args, 1024, return_lse=False)
+
+        with (
+            mock.patch.object(self.mod, "_FI_RUNNER_API", None),
+            mock.patch.object(
+                fi_core, "CuteDslMlaDecodeRunner", CuteDslMlaDecodeRunner
+            ),
+            mock.patch.object(
+                fi_core, "TrtllmGenMlaDecodeRunner", TrtllmGenMlaDecodeRunner
+            ),
+        ):
+            self.mod._TACTIC_CACHE.clear()
+            api = self.mod._flashinfer_runner_api()
+            self.assertIsNotNone(api)
+            self.assertEqual(api[-2], {"return_lse_base": None})
+            self.assertEqual(api[-1], {"return_lse_base": None})
+            miss = self._cached(*args, 1024)
+            hit = self._cached(*args, 1024)
+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(miss, ref))
+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(hit, ref))
+            self.assertGreaterEqual(len(seen_cute), 1)
+            self.assertGreaterEqual(len(seen_trtllm), 2)
+            self.assertIsNone(seen_cute[0]["return_lse_base"])
+            self.assertIsNone(seen_trtllm[0]["return_lse_base"])
+            self.assertIsNone(seen_trtllm[1]["return_lse_base"])
+
+        class _TrtllmUnknownRequired:
+            def __init__(self, *, future_required_param):
+                pass
+
+        class _TrtllmDroppedSuppliedKw:
+            def __init__(self, *, kv_cache):
+                pass
+
+        self.assertIsNone(
+            self.mod._probe_runner_extra_kwargs(
+                _TrtllmDroppedSuppliedKw, self.mod._TRTLLM_GEN_RUNNER_PARAMS
+            )
+        )
+
+        with mock.patch.object(self.mod, "_FI_RUNNER_API", None):
+            with mock.patch.object(
+                fi_core, "TrtllmGenMlaDecodeRunner", _TrtllmUnknownRequired
+            ):
+                self.assertIsNone(self.mod._flashinfer_runner_api())
+            self.assertIs(self.mod._FI_RUNNER_API, False)
+            with mock.patch.object(
+                self.mod, "_public_decode", wraps=self.mod._public_decode
+            ) as pub_mock:
+                self.mod._TACTIC_CACHE.clear()
+                out = self._cached(*args, 1024)
+            self.assertEqual(pub_mock.call_count, 1)
+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(out, ref))
+            self.assertEqual(len(self.mod._TACTIC_CACHE), 0)
+
+    def test_non_sm10x_delegates_to_public_api(self):
+        args = _make_inputs(2, 16, [1024] * 2, 1024 // _PAGE_SIZE, seed=19)
+        ref = self._public(*args, 1024, return_lse=False)
+        with mock.patch.object(self.mod, "_device_info", return_value=(12, 188)):
+            out = self._cached(*args, 1024)
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(out, ref))
+        self.assertEqual(len(self.mod._TACTIC_CACHE), 0)
+
+    def test_invalid_and_boundary_inputs_match_public_api_contract(self):
+        q, kv, bt, sl = _make_inputs(2, 16, [1024] * 2, 1024 // _PAGE_SIZE, seed=23)
+        ref = self.mod._public_decode(
+            **self._kwargs(q, kv, bt, sl, 1024),
+            bmm2_scale=1.0,
+            multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer=None,
+            out=None,
+            return_lse=False,
+            enable_pdl=None,
+            backend="trtllm-gen",
+        )
+        out = self._cached(q, kv, bt, sl, 1024, enable_pdl=None)
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(out, ref))
+        for bad_kwargs in (
+            dict(query=q.squeeze(1)),
+            dict(seq_lens=None),
+            dict(
+                out=torch.empty(
+                    (2, 1, 16, _KV_LORA_RANK), dtype=torch.float16, device="cuda"
+                )
+            ),
+            dict(kv_lora_rank=128),
+        ):
+            kw = self._kwargs(q, kv, bt, sl, 1024)
+            kw.update(bad_kwargs)
+            with self.assertRaises((ValueError, TypeError, RuntimeError)):
+                self.mod.cached_trtllm_mla_decode(**kw)
+
+    def test_rejects_unknown_backend(self):
+        args = _make_inputs(1, 16, [64], 1, seed=1)
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+            self._cached(*args, 64, backend="auto")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

issue_comments.body:
Could a maintainer add `run-ci` and review? Every test job was skipped; the red checks are `pr-gate` and the `*-finish` jobs that wait on it.

In eager decode (`--disable-cuda-graph`, or batches above `cuda_graph_max_bs`), FlashInfer rebuilds its MLA decode runners and runs `AutoTuner.choose_one` once per layer per step. This PR caches only the chosen `(runner, tactic)` per shape, no tensors, behind `SGLANG_TRTLLM_MLA_CACHE_DECODE_RUNNER` (default off). Outputs are bitwise identical to the public API, untuned and after `flashinfer.autotune(True)`; CUDA-graph replay does not change.

flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#8233 proposes the same cache inside FlashInfer. On builds that expose `AutoTuner.selection_cache_token` (added there), this helper calls the public API unchanged, so the two PRs do not conflict.

Test: `test/registered/attention/test_trtllm_mla_decode_cache.py`.
